metadata.methodology: Primary region is inferred from the RuneScape Wiki quest start-area field, then adjusted only where League region boundaries have stronger evidence. Required regions are the union of that primary region and recursively required quest regions from Module:Questreq/data. Catalyst is used as historical League precedent for ambiguous localities: it grouped both City of Um and Fort Forinthry under Misthalin, while Equilibrium's official reveal explicitly places Daemonheim in Forinthry (Wilderness). These are planner mappings, not an Equilibrium quest auto-completion list. Official auto-completions remain a separate Jagex-only overlay.

metadata.note: Supplemental region seeds for the 3D board's plate partition, in RuneScape surface coordinates (x east, y north) — the same space as src/map/data/gameCoords.ts. These are rendering hints, never league data. Every place anchor already seeds its own region; these only cover stretches of land no anchor is near, so the partition does not hand an empty moor to whichever town happens to be closest across a mountain range. Offshore packs: Ashdale + Iron Enclave (asgarnia; quest primary_region). Soul Wars surface island ~2210,2890 west of Feldip is MISTHALIN (user ruling for Equilibrium — dense seeds so the landmass does not split between tirannwn/kandarin; never place Misthalin seeds on The Lost Grove island ~1860-2040,3040-3260). Tirannwn plate = Prif + Isafdar + Lost Grove + Port Tyras; cuts off at Arandar pass entrance (wiki map 2345,3283 — Kandarin owns the gate/pass eastward) and claims the SE brown-rock edge of Isafdar (~2260-2390,3030-3155), not Castle Wars (~2440) or Feldip. Forinthry hard dark-gray floor north of the ditch is wilderness even west of Edgeville (~2952+); Asgarnia keeps only the brown troll ridge (Death Plateau / Trollheim / GWD). Brimhaven NW coast islets reclaim (karamja; Holy Grail whistle tower coast). Fisher Realm is OFF-BOARD: wiki leagueRegion=Karamja, mapID 400/401 at y~4703 north of MAP_BOUNDS.maxY 4608 — do not invent surface seeds from Ashdale/Feldip. SALVE CORRIDOR: Dig Site/Silvarea vs Mort Myre cannot be held by Euclidean seeds alone (towns too close) — scripts/build-map-terrain.mjs hard-forces Misthalin for map x<=3396 in the dig-site band and Morytania for x>=3402 in the swamp/bridge band (desert excluded). Run `npm run build:map` after editing.
